basic_info.description: Most engineers debug errors. I debug chaos ..lol, real though. I’m Onyeibor Samuel, a backend-focused full-stack developer who brings clarity to messy systems using TypeScript, Python, and cloud tech. I’ve built and shipped live products that real people use every day, not just portfolio pieces, and I believe clean code is a form of respect: to users, to teammates, and to the future. I craft scalable software that feels simple, no matter how complex the backend. I don’t just solve problems.., I make them disappear. And while I’ve already shipped things that matter, I’m even more excited by what I haven’t learned yet. I'm currently advancing into my third year of Electrical and Electronics Engineering, hungry to grow, learning, and ready to earn my place, one commit at a time.

projects.title: Sunjokia Everafter
projects.description: Sunjokia Everafter is a live matchmaking and connection platform with 1,000+ active users across the US, UK, and other countries. I designed, built, and deployed the entire backend from the ground up: profiles, discovery and matching, messaging, notifications, and an admin panel. Along the way I tracked down and fixed a nasty email-deliverability bug that was sending verification and password-reset emails straight to spam, rebuilt the image-upload pipeline after a Firebase Storage token issue broke profile photos for everyone, and built GPS-based location capture with reverse geocoding to power region-aware discovery. I also rewrote a permission component as a state machine to fix gnarly Safari/iOS edge cases and shipped a string of admin panel improvements.

projects.title: TrueTrader
projects.description: TrueTrader is an AI-powered trading journal and analytics platform. I joined mid-build to take over backend, DevOps, and QA on a FastAPI/PostgreSQL/Docker stack hosted on AWS. The most interesting problem: integrating with cTrader's Protobuf-based Open API over WebSockets, including a multi-step authentication flow and symbol-ID-to-name resolution, to pull live trades, journals, and account data where a REST-based approach wasn't working. I also designed and built a complete broker file upload and parsing system supporting MT4, MT5, and other trade-history formats, normalizing wildly different column structures so uploaded trades flow straight into the platform's analytics, AI insights, and chat features. On top of that: full DevSecOps on the production AWS server, broker-connection bug fixes, and QA across the platform.

projects.title: IkonetU
projects.description: IkonetU connects startup founders with investors. I designed and built the platform end to end across three codebases: a Django REST Framework backend, a TypeScript/React admin dashboard, and a TypeScript/Express + PostgreSQL (Drizzle ORM) web application. Founders, investors, and admins all get real-time messaging and notifications via WebSockets (Django Channels and Node ws), and there's a media upload/processing pipeline built with FFmpeg for pitch video content. Authentication and role-based access run on JWT/Passport. I deployed and manage the whole stack on Render.

projects.title: Bitexly
projects.description: Bitexly is a full-stack cryptocurrency exchange platform that I designed, built, and hosted from scratch, integrating 5 third-party exchange and on-ramp providers (MoonPay, SimpleSwap, LetsExchange, Exolix, and FinchPay) into a single unified backend. The Django REST Framework backend handles JWT authentication, Stripe payments, Cloudinary media, and Redis-backed real-time features via Django Channels, with a React/Vite frontend on top. I set up and manage deployment on a VPS with Nginx and Gunicorn.

projects.title: Matchki
projects.description: Matchki is a real-time chat platform built for an international client as a TypeScript monorepo: a Next.js frontend, an Express API, and Prisma over PostgreSQL, with real-time messaging powered by Socket.io. Authentication runs on JWT and payments on Stripe. I built and deployed the whole thing on Render.
